cases.evidence_condition: Exact v0.4.1 synthetic profile; immutable declarative artifacts and every selected local technical gate pass.
cases.minimum_next_action: Retain the synthetic package and obtain external provider and real-artifact evidence before promotion review.

cases.evidence_condition: Provider tag, source revision, Python identity, dependency lock, or environment profile is unpinned or drifted.
cases.minimum_next_action: Create and forward-validate an exact provider/environment profile.

cases.evidence_condition: Artifact bytes disagree with the request hash, or result model hashes detach from network/thermochemistry bytes.
cases.minimum_next_action: Restore immutable bytes or issue one reviewed lineage replacement.

cases.evidence_condition: An elementary reaction has undefined species or violates elemental/site balance.
cases.minimum_next_action: Correct the declarative network before adding kinetic evidence.

cases.evidence_condition: Energy, pressure, temperature, coverage, rate unit, or active-site normalization is missing or unsupported.
cases.minimum_next_action: Normalize units and bind rate values to one declared active-site basis.

cases.evidence_condition: Species energy/provenance is incomplete or forward/reverse barriers violate thermodynamic cycle closure.
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve references, energy components, provenance, and barriers before solving.

cases.evidence_condition: Solver self-reports convergence but residual, predeclared tolerance, multi-initial-state count, fingerprints, or final coverages disagree.
cases.minimum_next_action: Preserve every branch and rerun the predeclared initialization set with stored residuals and final states.

cases.evidence_condition: Coverage bounds/site closure or stoichiometrically derived surface-species production residuals fail.
cases.minimum_next_action: Resolve site accounting, rate mapping, and the selected steady-state branch.

cases.evidence_condition: Calibration and evaluation IDs overlap, sensitivity branch/scales are incomplete, or uncertainty sampling/provenance/intervals are incomplete.
cases.minimum_next_action: Separate data partitions and complete branch-bound sensitivity and uncertainty evidence.

cases.evidence_condition: Automation is asked to assert a true or unique mechanism, unique steady state, RDS, causal ranking, or experiment agreement.
cases.minimum_next_action: Limit output to conditional technical evidence and obtain an independent scientific decision.
